name: Lavinia Plonka
reason: Previous reason still holds (her site was read earlier today, 4 Nov 2026, so not re-fetched): her work is mainly Feldenkrais somatic education whose catalogue is largely framed around body problems (back and neck pain, TMJ, balance and falls, eyesight, chronic pain), so most items fail the health rule.
